title: Registry Source Record
description: Canonical record for a data/information source that feeds entities or events into OneMind. Lives in the KV_SOURCE_REGISTRY bucket and is emitted on the registry.source.{id} subject. A source is the origin system (e.g. Home Assistant, ADS-B, AIS, ACLED, om-unity) that discovers and feeds entities.

kind.description: Source category — what type of system this source represents.

status.description: Current connection/health status of the source.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what this source provides.

subjects.description: NATS subjects this source publishes on.

events.description: Event subject pattern this source emits (e.g. 'evt.world.air.>').

telemetry.description: Telemetry subject pattern this source emits.

entity_count.description: Number of entities currently discovered from this source.

tak_projection.description: Whether this source's entities are projected into TAK by default.

last_seen.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the last activity from this source.

config.description: Source-specific configuration (endpoint, credentials ref, poll interval, etc.). No secrets stored inline — use credential references.
